text:
alex: Heads-up — I need to swap my 10:30 deploy slot with @maya's 11:15 slot due to a client demo. Can we confirm owners + smoke for both? Proposed: I take 11:15 (non-db change), maya takes 10:30 (small perf tweak).

maya: ok for me, swapping is fine. I can take the 10:30 slot if you want me to own the quicker perf check. who will be primary smoke for 10:30?

kevin: @alex @maya quick q — does the 10:30 tweak touch any feature flags? if yes we need a gated rollback plan.

alex: no feature-flag flips. it's a config parallelism tweak only. rollback plan: revert config, redeploy previous image, monitor p95. I will be primary rollback owner for whatever slot I take. @deploy-bot please note the swap request.

deploy-bot: schedule-update: slot-swap requested by alex. proposed assignment: 10:30 -> maya, 11:15 -> alex. Approval pending from both owners and smoke owners.

sam: I can run smoke for 10:30 if needed. smoke checklist I'll run: 1) /health OK, 2) basic e2e scenario, 3) p95 < 300ms, 4) trace samples. I can kick a dry-run at 10:20.

anya: I have a calendar conflict 11:00-11:30 but can be on-call for rollback 11:15-11:45. @kevin will you be secondary?

kevin: yep I can be secondary. happy to take PagerDuty if needed.

alex: great. also proposing to set canary autostop: 2 errors in 5m -> autostop. config snippet to add to canary:
```
canary.threshold.errors: 2
canary.window: 5m
canary.action: autostop
```
That keeps the swap safe and fast to abort.

maya: FYI my 10:30 change touches a client header only, no schema/db changes. I'll ping QA for a quick regression pass.

sam: smoke run link: https://ci.redwood/smoke/runs/172345 — I'll run dry at 10:20 and post results here.

maya: I just updated the Console owner for 10:30 -> maya and 11:15 -> alex. alex please add rollback details to the deploy doc.

alex: done — deploy doc: https://docs.redwood/deploys/1723456789-swap. Rollback steps and contact list are included. also tagging the release: `git tag deploy/1723456789-swap`.

deploy-bot: deploy-schedule: 10:30 maya -> status: pending; 11:15 alex -> status: pending. Quiet window set: 10:15-10:45 for 10:30 slot. Reminder: enable canary autostop as configured.

maya: all good from my side :+1:

anya: I'll monitor PagerDuty 11:00-11:45 and be ready to escalate.

kevin: thanks team, good luck :rocket:
